title: Ad Policies, Rejections & Account Health
objectives: Navigate Meta Advertising Standards and avoid sudden ad rejections or disablements
Identify common policy triggers: personal attributes, before/after imagery, misleading claims, and financial guarantees
Master the appeals protocol to restore restricted ad accounts and Business Managers

blocks.text: Nothing stops revenue faster than a disabled ad account! Knowing Meta's advertising policies inside out makes you invaluable to any brand.
Meta relies on automated AI bots to review ads. Understanding what triggers these algorithms helps you write compelling copy that converts without getting banned.

blocks.title: Top 5 Frequent Policy Violations in India
items: 1. Personal Attributes: Never imply or call out a user's sensitive traits directly (e.g., 'Are you suffering from hair loss?' violates policy; 'Discover our Ayurvedic scalp care routine' is compliant).
2. Unrealistic & Before/After Claims: Side-by-side weight loss or extreme acne transformations will trigger instant rejection.
3. Financial & Get-Rich Guarantees: Promising specific stock trading returns, easy side-hustle money, or guaranteed wealth is prohibited.
4. Landing Page Mismatch: If your ad talks about protein powder but links to an affiliate blog with pop-up ads, your account gets flagged.
5. Circumventing Systems: Creating a new ad account to bypass restrictions on an existing account will lead to a permanent Business Manager ban.

blocks.title: The Airport Security Scanner
blocks.text: Meta's automated reviewer is like an airport baggage scanner. It searches for specific flag keywords ('cure', 'guaranteed cash', 'weight loss in 3 days'). If it sees them, your bag is held for inspection even if your product is completely legitimate.
Always request human review inside Account Quality. Automated bots reject innocent copy up to 30% of the time. A polite, evidence-backed appeal often restores the ad within 24-48 hours.
Never use the same credit card across multiple ad accounts if one account has unpaid balances or severe policy violations, as Meta may link and ban the entire billing profile.

quiz.q: Which ad copy headline strictly violates Meta's 'Personal Attributes' policy?
options: Discover nourishing ayurvedic scalp oil for stronger roots
Are you suffering from severe belly fat and low self-esteem?
3 tips to maintain high energy during long workdays
Explore premium ergonomic chairs designed for developers
quiz.explain: Calling out specific personal health conditions or physical insecurities directly ('Are you suffering from...') violates Meta's personal attributes policy.

quiz.q: What should you do first when an ad gets rejected by Meta's automated review system for an incorrect reason?
options: Create a brand new Facebook profile and register a new company
Check Meta Account Quality, review the specific flagged policy, adjust if needed, and request a human review
Immediately sue Meta in local court
Duplicate the exact same rejected ad 50 times
quiz.explain: Navigating to Account Quality to review the policy flag and requesting a manual human review is the standard operating procedure.

quiz.q: Why are extreme 'Before and After' split photos banned for health, cosmetic, and fitness ads on Meta?
options: They often generate unrealistic expectations and negative self-perception among users
Meta's servers cannot store two pictures in one ad
Before and After photos are patented by Google
quiz.explain: Meta restricts dramatic before-and-after imagery to protect user well-being and prevent misleading expectations.
